text: Big Data Management and Application is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates data science, management, and information technology (professional code: 120108T), belonging to the category of management. It lasts for four years and confers a Bachelor of Management or a Bachelor of Science degree. This major focuses on researching how to apply big data technology to solve management decision-making problems, optimizing organizational operations and driving business innovation by mining the value of data. Its core lies in transforming massive amounts of data (structured and unstructured data) into decision-making bases, covering multiple fields such as government, enterprises, finance, and healthcare. It is a key major that connects technology and management in the digital economy era.
